title: AI assistants for health professionals' learning
why: AI can explain concepts, generate practice questions and summarise long guidance — useful for revision and CPD.
what_is_different: Health professionals must never rely on AI for clinical decisions, must verify against guidelines and trusted references, and must never enter identifiable patient information.

extra_modules.title: Revision with spaced repetition
extra_modules.outcome: You can: turn guidelines into flashcards
extra_modules.practice: Create 20 verified flashcards from a guideline

starter_project: Build a monthly CPD routine: summarise one guideline update with AI, verify against the source, create flashcards, and log reflections.

expert_validation.note: AI-drafted outline; to be validated by a practitioner and an educator in this field.
